text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for everything today, Trainer!
See ya
tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I part ways with Taiki and start walking
back to
my place. But the next
moment...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Plip, plop...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It starts to rain. ...Unfortunately, I don't
have an
umbrella on me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'd better hurry back...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Traineeer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Phew! Caught ya just in time!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I brought ya an umbrella! This oughta
keep ya
dry!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Whoops! Gosh, I'm such a scatterbrain!
choice_data_list: ……傘、差してないみたいだけど
choice_data_list_en: ...Looks like you're not using an umbrella, though.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, all right! Let's head back
together!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taiki brings me under her umbrella, and
we walk
to my place together.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yay, we made it back safe and sound!
What a
relief!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hehe! You're welcome!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Heh—guess buyin' that foldin' umbrella
ya showed
me was the right choice!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look at the umbrella propped up by
the
entrance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the same one we bought together at
the mall.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Haha, I'm glad I got some use out of it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Haha, I'm glad I got some use out of it!
choice_data_list: 迎えに来てくれてありがとう
あの時はしぶしぶ買ってたけどね
貸しが出来ちゃったな
貸しが出来ちゃったね
choice_data_list_en: Thanks for coming to pick me up.
I only bought it reluctantly back then, though.
Guess you owe me one now.
Guess you owe me one now, huh?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you betcha! Don't worry 'bout a
thing!
choice_data_list: 迎えに来てくれてありがとう
あの時はしぶしぶ買ってたけどね
貸しが出来ちゃったな
貸しが出来ちゃったね
choice_data_list_en: Thanks for coming to pick me up.
I only bought it reluctantly back then, though.
Guess you owe me one now.
Guess you owe me one now, huh?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You're always workin' so hard for my
sake,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So that's why I wanna do whatever I can
to return
the favor!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, helpin' ya out today has made me
awful
happy! What a great day!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taiki Shuttle shoots me a warm smile.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Haha... Sorry 'bout that.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Umbrellas sure are handy though.
Today's been a
real eye-opener.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I can't wait till it rains again!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
If ya ever find yourself in a fix, I'll come
pick ya
up, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle beams brightly as she
makes her
promise.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh! Sayin' ya owe me a favor?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Haha, it's my lucky day! Well, you can
pay me
back next time it rains!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
All ya gotta do is come and pick me up.
That all
right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle shoots me a mischievous
grin.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Weeell~... You don't need to worry about it~.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Because you're always looking out for ME!
So that means no keeping score between us, YES!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, but—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
If you insist on returning the favor,
I will not refuse.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hehe, that's true~... Well then~...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
How about we go on another fun outing next time?
Then we'll be all square!♪

With a happy expression, Taiki Shuttle
made that request.
